answer: The statutory auditors' limited-assurance certification covers the 2025 sustainability information in section 5.2, including ESRS compliance/process and EU Taxonomy Article 8 disclosures. It does not assess the relevance or ambition of action plans, targets, policies, scenarios or transition plans, and does not cover compliance with the vigilance plan; limited assurance also uses fewer procedures than reasonable assurance. A separate reasonable-assurance engagement covers only selected 2025 operated-perimeter Climate Indicators: gross Scope 1 (31.8 MtCO2e), gross market-based Scope 2 (1.3 MtCO2e), Scope 1+2 market-based (33.1 MtCO2e), and gross methane (22.5 kt CH4). It excludes comparative periods and all other 2025 URD information. The reasonable engagement cites ISAE 3000 (Revised) and CNCC professional guidance.
